SYMPTOM: POST to gemini-image-3-pro-preview or gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview returns 500 Internal Error when prompt includes a person/portrait

CAUSE: Default safety filters block person generation even for realistic portrait prompts

FIX: Add safetySettings to the request body:
```js
safetySettings: [
  { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
  { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
  { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' },
  { category: 'HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH', threshold: 'BLOCK_NONE' }
]
```

PREVENT: Always include safetySettings for any prompt involving people, portraits, or realistic humans
